events.title: Fallen Nights is in Steam Next Fest. Can you make it to the boat?
events.summary: One river. One boat. One way out. Fallen Nights is part of Steam Next Fest, October 19–26! Try the free Riverside demo. Gather scrap during the day, choose your perks, and build defenses before the zombies arrive at night. Your goal is to repair the boat and get away. There is one catch: repairs and defenses need the same scrap. How much will you spend to survive tonight, and how much will you save for your escape? New here? Start with Riverside. events.title: The Fallen Nights Demo Is Live on Steam!
events.summary: Today I released the free demo of Fallen Nights. Seeing something I’ve been building become a game people can actually download and play is a big moment for me. Scavenge during the day, build your defenses, and survive the zombies at night. Your goal is to repair the boat and escape. events.title: The Fallen Nights Demo Arrives October 8
events.summary: The free Fallen Nights demo arrives on Steam on October 8, 2026! Build your defenses. Fight the horde. Repair your way out. Head to Riverside, scavenge for scrap, and prepare your camp before the zombies arrive. Build defenses and fight alongside them while you repair the boat that can get you out. Every piece of scrap is a choice: more firepower to survive the next attack, or another step toward escape? I'd love your feedback Once you've played, leave a comment here or visit the Steam Discussio
